title: Saudi Arabian Salmon Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish from the Middle East, featuring succulent salmon and a fragrant pilaf.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add salmon fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer salmon to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Add more oil to the skillet if necessary, then add pilaf spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add rice to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until lightly toasted.
Add water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Stir in saffron threads and cook for 1 minute.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and stir in chopped dates.
Serve salmon on top of pilaf and garnish with additional dates if desired.
